messages:
kevin: heads up — we're seeing a spike in fncall validation failures from hosted API; console shows a big 'tool_reject' band and mass fallbacks to the degen route :eyes:

maria: saw it. looks correlated with the strict-validate canary we pushed at 12:30 UTC. majority are 'invalid_response_shape' where adapters return arrays instead of objects.

ashok: ugh. current metric is just invoke.error so it's impossible to separate schema vs runtime. noisy and not actionable.

nora: proposal: add an error_class label on invoke errors. values: schema, runtime, timeout, partial. include adapter_version and validator_version as tags.

samir: another problem: billing. quota/accounting is counting original invoke + fallback invoke as two billable calls (double charge). that's customer visible.

julia: console UX: dashboard groups by HTTP code and model only. we need a dedicated "fncall.validation" view that shows top failing adapters, error_class, validator score histogram, plus a small list of redacted samples.

kevin: log sample: ```json
{"invoke_id":"i-123","error":"invalid_response_shape","tool":"price_service","response":"[\"1\",\"2\"]","adapter_version":"v2.1"}
```
(this is one of the raw failure entries)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back strict-validate canary from 2 -> 1 at 12:43 UTC (reason: spike in validation errors).

maria: for routing: instead of immediate degen fallback, can we try 'adapter-shim' first for schema failures? shim could coerce arrays->object when trivial. need to be careful with semantics.

ashok: router policy is fine, but we need the extra telemetry to tag retries as 'retry_of=<invoke_id>' so billing can be exempted or attributed. adding a header is easiest.

samir: agree. billing change: treat retries with retry_of header as non-billable for quota usage, but still count them in observability. will need to update accounting pipeline.

julia: I can mock up the console card: top failing callers, toggle sample rate, and an "inspect" button that pulls a redacted sample. suggestion: default sample 0.5% and opt-in to increase.

nora: telemetry ask: also capture validator.score (0-1) and adapter-version in the time-series so we can detect regressions after adapter deploys. add a small histogram on the card.

kevin: ownership check — ops rolled back the canary. next steps: eng-platform to add error_class label + retry_of header; billing to make retries no-bill; console to add card; telemetry to add validator tags.

maria: I'll follow up with a postmortem-lite once we have sample traces. can everyone drop a quick PR ETA? :thumbsup:

ashok: adding label + header PR by EOD.

samir: billing pipeline change early next week (need infra window).

julia: console card draft by tomorrow afternoon.

nora: telemetry labels PR in the same branch as ashok to keep releases aligned.

kevin: thanks all — keeping this thread open for status updates. if you find sensitive data in samples, redact and ping security.

maria: noted. starting sample collection with redaction rules now.
